Where do you think he will go first?
He will go straight to the very best restaurant.
Your restaurant without me is no longer the best.
You will have a chance to get a Michelin star!
Dima, I have very little time right now.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
Present есть; у меня есть = I have.

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

examples.text: Я и сама хорошо проведу время.
examples.trans: I'll have a good time on my own.

related.gloss: to reach, walk as far as

дослушать.gloss: to hear out, to listen to the end

meanings.en: to hear out, to listen to the end

examples.trans: You probably did not listen to the end.

examples.text: Подожди, Витя, дослушай меня до конца.
examples.trans: Wait, Vitya, hear me out to the end.

meanings.note: думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.

meanings.note: condition: если хочешь = if you want; а если нет? = and if not?

examples.text: Дима, не забывай, что ресторан ты мне продал.
examples.trans: Dima, don't forget that you sold me the restaurant.
There are bright stars in the sky.

examples.text: Вот молодёжь, ничего не знают! Это же Лещенко! Звезда!
examples.trans: Young people these days, they don't know anything! That's Leshchenko! A star!

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: From Latin 'inspector' (observer, overseer, from 'inspicere', to look into).

examples.text: Инспекторы ищут нарушения только ради денег.
examples.trans: Inspectors look for violations only for money.
The inspector is checking the kitchen.

meanings.note: Как вы знаете = as you know.

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!

meanings.note: the 'е' drops out in the other forms

examples.trans: At the end of the film everyone is happy.

meanings.note: For movement; где is for location.

examples.trans: Wait, where are you two going?

meanings.note: лучший в мире = the best in the world

examples.text: Ты мне даёшь пятьсот рублей, а я выхожу и покупаю тебе лучшую приставку в мире.
examples.trans: You give me five hundred roubles, and I get out and buy you the best console in the world.

examples.text: Подождите! Два дня — это же очень мало.
examples.trans: Hold on! Two days is far too little.
Which car did you come in?

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

related.gloss: long ago, for a long time

meanings.note: accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

подогнать.gloss: to bring (a car) round; to adjust, fit; to get (someone something)

meanings.en: to bring (a vehicle) up, drive round

meanings.note: Colloquial: мне подогнали машину = I got hooked up with a car.

examples.text: Ты дашь охраннику, чтобы через полчаса подогнал к веранде.
examples.trans: You'll give it to the guard so he brings it round to the veranda in half an hour.

examples.text: Посмотри, какую машину мне недавно подогнали.
examples.trans: Look what car I got hooked up with recently.

examples.text: Подожди, Нин, ты не поняла. Это же стыдно!
examples.trans: Wait, Nina, you don't get it. It's shameful!

meanings.en: to think it over, to give it a thought

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.
Can I go and have a look?

examples.text: А кто их получит? Те, кто сидит повыше?
examples.trans: And who will get it? The people who sit higher up?

meanings.en: to have a look, to take a look

examples.trans: Can I go and have a look?

meanings.note: from a trip, by car, train or plane

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?
Which car did you come in?

examples.text: Вика, ты на какой машине сегодня приехала?
examples.trans: Vika, which car did you come in today?

принимать.gloss: to receive, to see (visitors); to take

examples.trans: The mayor isn't seeing anyone today.
The doctor sees patients in the morning.

examples.text: Я ему сказала, что сегодня вы не принимаете.
examples.trans: I told him you're not seeing anyone today.

meanings.note: takes the accusative; everyday synonym of о

examples.trans: He says nasty things about me.

examples.text: Как интересно! А в Москве ты про меня гадости рассказываешь.
examples.trans: How interesting! And in Moscow you go around saying nasty things about me.

meanings.note: Dining establishment. Borrowed from French 'restaurant' (from 'restaurer', to restore strength with rich broth); entered Russian in the early 19th century.

examples.trans: They called from the Italian restaurant.
In the evening they went to a restaurant.

examples.text: Кстати, звонили из итальянского ресторана. Дарят папе романтический ужин на двоих.
examples.trans: By the way, they called from the Italian restaurant. They're giving Dad a romantic dinner for two.

meanings.note: forms the superlative: самый главный = the most important

examples.trans: The most important thing is the people.
Do you know the main thing?

examples.text: Свежие ягоды, кофе! У вас тут романтический завтрак.
examples.trans: Fresh berries, coffee! You are having a romantic breakfast here.

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?
Admit it / Don't you agree, that's much better.

examples.text: Это гораздо лучше, чем двенадцать лет. Согласитесь?
examples.trans: That's much better than twelve years. Don't you agree?
You can see it at once.
Now there's a businesswoman, you can see it at once.

examples.text: Ты ведь тайно обманываешь своего лучшего друга Андрея!
examples.trans: You are secretly deceiving your best friend Andrey!

examples.text: В Москву тайно приехал инспектор Мишлен.
examples.trans: A Michelin inspector has secretly arrived in Moscow.

examples.text: Я завтра тайно приглашу её на романтический ужин.
examples.trans: Tomorrow I'll secretly invite her to a romantic dinner.
Is the car in place? Did you check?

examples.text: Он припарковал старую тачку во дворе.
examples.trans: He parked the old car in the yard.

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

examples.text: Мы же здесь выросли. И о людях тоже надо думать.
examples.trans: After all, we grew up here. And you have to think about people too.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.

examples.text: Будешь готовить форель с обычным жюльеном.
examples.trans: You'll cook the trout with an ordinary julienne.

examples.text: Сейчас свежую форель привезли, пойду принимать.
examples.trans: Fresh trout has just been delivered, I'll go take it in.

examples.text: Какое хорошее утро! Лидия Алексеевна, чашку кофе, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: What a lovely morning! Lidia Alekseyevna, a cup of coffee, please.

meanings.note: У меня есть шанс = I have a chance.

examples.text: А у меня все шансы есть. Жена, двое детей, не сидел, служил в армии.
examples.trans: And I've got every chance. A wife, two kids, no prison record, I served in the army.

meanings.note: alone: 'я этого не хочу' = I don't want that

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

examples.text: Меня уже тошнит от этой коммуналки! У нас труба уже неделю течёт.
examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat! Our pipe has been leaking for a week now.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
